description: Depth and tide, rising. The depth shown is below the transducer. At 10 s the transducer reading fails (null) and the page and tile move to below the keel, naming it. At 25 s the keel and surface readings fail too and depth is NO DATA. At 40 s the tide plugin goes quiet: the height goes stale after 30 minutes, so the page keeps the tide until then.

after.note: transducer reading fails (null): falls back to keel
keel and surface fail: no depth
